title: Asymptotics of the Number of Components of Random Polynomial Lemniscates
summary: Consider a sequence of random polynomials $P_n(z) = \prod_{k=1}^{n}(z - X_k)$, where $\{X_k\}_k$ are i.i.d. random variables distributed uniformly on the unit disc $\mathbb{D}$. Let $Λ_n = \{z \in \mathbb{C}: |P_n(z)| < 1\}$ be the lemniscate of $P_n$, and let $\mathscr{C}(Λ_n)$ be the number of connected components of $Λ_n$. In this paper, we prove that $\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{\mathbb{E}[\mathscr{C}(Λ_n)]}{\sqrt{n}}= γ$, and identify the constant $γ$.
